item.title: Malaysian Pharma Monitoring Potential Drug Supply Disruptions; Medical Devices, Supplies, Packaging At Risk Too
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Malaysian pharma suppliers are monitoring potential medicine supply disruptions from the Iran war. India, a major generics producer, comprises >30% of Malaysia's imported drug supply. Medical devices (MRI scanners), supplies, and packaging are at risk too.
